# Agent Python Tools

- repo: berriai/litellm
- repo_uri: https://github.com/berriai/litellm

## File: berriai_litellm/cookbook/anthropic_agent_sdk/common.py

Prompts

```
['fetch available model IDs from a LiteLLM proxy models endpoint using an async HTTP client', 'set ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variables from a LiteLLM Config object', 'print an interactive chat header showing the connected LiteLLM gateway URL and current model', 'display available models and let the user pick one to switch to interactively', 'stream an agent response by querying the client and printing content block deltas in real time']
```

Usage

```
{'fetch_available_models': 'fetch available model IDs from a LiteLLM proxy models endpoint using an async HTTP client', 'setup_litellm_env': 'set ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variables from a LiteLLM Config object', 'print_header': 'print an interactive chat header showing the connected LiteLLM gateway URL and current model', 'handle_model_switch': 'display available models and let the user pick one to switch to interactively', 'stream_response': 'stream an agent response by querying the client and printing content block deltas in real time'}
```
